about: How sure DBaba is of each finding when it has only the query text (night 11). Shared by every engine (standing rule B): the engine-specific commands that check a fact (EXPLAIN, the index list) are in each dialect file under 'verify'. A finding's class comes from what it depends on: nothing beyond the SQL text (proven), the data or the intent (likely risk), a fact about the tables (needs schema), or the running database (needs execution). Lab-proven on MariaDB and PostgreSQL in tests/practice/test_night11.py.

proven.why_en: The SQL text alone shows it: the database refuses it, or it returns wrong rows on any data.
proven.why_hi: Sirf SQL text se dikhta hai: database ise mana karega, ya kisi bhi data pe galat rows dega.

likely_risk.why_en: The shape of the query suggests it, but whether it bites depends on the data (how many rows match) or on what you meant.
likely_risk.why_hi: Query ki shakal se lagta hai, par asar data (kitni rows milti hain) ya aapke matlab pe tika hai.

needs_schema.why_en: It depends on a fact the query doesn't show: whether a column can be NULL, is a key, holds a time of day, or what type it is.
needs_schema.why_hi: Ye us fact pe tika hai jo query mein nahi dikhta: column NULL ho sakta hai ya nahi, key hai ya nahi, time rakhta hai ya nahi, ya uska type.

needs_execution.why_en: A speed risk: whether it is really slow depends on the indexes, the row counts and the plan the database picks.
needs_execution.why_hi: Speed ka risk: sach mein slow hai ya nahi ye index, rows ki ginti aur database ke plan pe tika hai.

not_null.hi: {col} NULL ho sakta hai ya nahi

has_time.en: whether {col} holds a time of day (DATETIME / TIMESTAMP) or only a date
has_time.hi: {col} mein time bhi hai (DATETIME / TIMESTAMP) ya sirf date

unique.en: whether ({col}) is unique in {table} (a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE)
unique.hi: ({col}) {table} mein unique hai ya nahi (PRIMARY KEY ya UNIQUE)

to_one.en: whether each row matches only one {table} row (is the join column a key of {table}?)
to_one.hi: har row ko sirf ek {table} row milti hai ya nahi ({table} ka join column key hai ya nahi)

index.en: whether an index starting with {col} exists
index.hi: {col} se shuru hone wala index hai ya nahi
